account.title: a2tools.app account
account.about: a2tools.app and its accounts are run by the A2Tools developer, not by Daevalog. When you upload a fight, Daevalog sends a2tools.app the game's network data from that one fight, with every character name in it swapped for a code. It also sends your character name, and the other players' names with the middle letters hidden. a2tools.app works out the numbers from that data and keeps the fight until you delete it.
account.rules: a2tools.app's own {privacy} covers your account and your uploads. For help with your a2tools.app account, {help}.
account.signInHint: Sign in to upload fights to your a2tools.app account. Daevalog only asks a2tools.app who you are and sends the fights you upload.
account.codePrompt: Check that your browser shows this code:
account.codeHint: A browser page should be open now. The code works for 10 minutes.
account.autoUploadHint: When a boss fight ends, Daevalog uploads it to your account with the visibility you set on a2tools.app. Other players' names stay hidden. Fights on training dummies are never uploaded.
account.autoUploadSignIn: Sign in above to use this.

sendLogs.openFolderTip: debug.log, the packet logs and prepared copies. For a problem with Daevalog, use Report a problem.

report.title: Report a problem
report.intro: Choose what went wrong. The form opens on GitHub in your browser, with the report info below filled in. Nothing is sent until you submit it there.

hint.wrongNumbers: Attach a prepared packet log of the fight, and the game's Combat Analysis record (Ctrl+X) if you have one.
hint.crashCopy: Press Prepare debug log. It saves report_debug.log to the log folder with character names, your home folder and your user name taken out. Issues are public, so look the file over before you attach it. If Enable debug logging is off, turn it on and make the problem happen again first.
hint.other: Anything else, ideas for new features too.
hint.security: For anything that could hurt other players or users if posted in public. Only the developer sees this report.

prepare.title: Prepare a packet log
prepare.hint: Packet logs hold the name of every player you met, and issues are public. Prepare log saves a copy to the log folder with every character name replaced. Its name starts with report_. Attach that copy. Chat messages can stay in it.
prepare.done: Saved {name}. The log folder is open.
prepare.none: No packet logs yet. Turn on Enable packet logging, play the fight again, then prepare a log.

report.recordFolderTip: The game's own records: one record_*.dat file each time you use Combat Analysis (Ctrl+X).
report.infoHint: This text goes into the issue. It holds no user name, character names or folder paths.
